description: Every declaration node carries a `leading_comments: string[]` field containing the verbatim leading JSDoc/comment blocks as they appear in source. This is the load-bearing contract that unblocks `react-component-library`'s migration off `@vrooliWidget*` / `@vrooliComponent*` regex scraping.

requirements.description: Every declaration node in the extracted graph must carry a leading_comments field containing a string array of verbatim leading JSDoc and comment blocks exactly as they appear in source, including whitespace-normalized block delimiters. This is a load-bearing contract: react-component-library depends on this field to replace its existing regex-based scraping of @vrooliWidget* and @vrooliComponent* annotations. Comments must be extracted from JSDoc blocks (/** ... */), line comments (//), and block comments (/* ... */) that directly precede the declaration with no intervening non-comment tokens.
requirements.title: Leading-Comment Metadata on All Declaration Nodes
